description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and driving continuous improvement in quality outcomes. This role offers a competitive annual salary reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence.Join a team committed to providing outstanding rehabilitation and long-term care services. We are looking for a leader who can inspire, innovate, and maintain the highest standards of operational efficiency and resident satisfaction.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills
Demonstrated ability to manage operations and drive quality outcomes
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, commensurate with experience.
